rules.text: KEEP both exact native envelopes, including all Druid/Mage/Wizard Conjuration rank9/class17/base26RP rows, Action,120feet,V/S/F. Convergence lasts one minute without concentration; Fusion requires concentration up to one minute. These procedures are proposed ordinary-spell authorship, not a replacement for native source bytes or an automatic repertoire grant. Require actual class advancement, learned/book/prepared entry, current Action, audible V, free gesturing hand and accessible focus, perception/LoE, complete eligible profile, legal geometry and affordable final price. rules.text: Convergence creates exactly Fire, Air, Earth and Water base pets. Preserve their accepted AC13/15/17/14, baseHP10/20/30/35, walk30, ordinary sight/hearing, owner PB saves and original attack/ability rules. Air makes TWO separate 1d6 slashing attacks in ONE commanded offensive Action; Earth one1d10 bludgeoning hit plus its separate Large-or-smaller STR save for Prone; Fire one1d8 fire hit; Water one1d10 cold hit OR one2d6 willing-ally heal. All attacks use original owner's actual casting-class spell attack, including an applicable school bonus once. No extra flight, swimming, burrow, resistance, equipment anatomy or material harvest. NEW only for Convergence-created bodies: missing Fire/Air/Earth ability scores are six10s; these do not replace their explicit owner-PB saves/checks+0. Fire mass20lb, box5x5x5feet; Air20lb,Earth300lb,Water150lb, each box5x5x5feet. Fire/Air Small, Earth/Water Medium. The specified geometry is a NEW body envelope for these instances, not a bestiary assertion. Air/Earth retain no cargo capacity; Fire gains none. Water retains actual entrusted cargo/capacity,150lb at STR10; no free hands or item activation. No Water healing classification is extended to Fire/Air/Earth.

rules.text: NEW one active Convergence parent per original caster; each parent has four independently addressable child identities, one per lower-pet family. Successful admission ends that caster's previous Convergence parent and any extant native lower pet of each four families, then installs all four atomically. Greater pets and differently named familiars are not replaced. A later successful native lower-pet cast replaces only its matching group child; its new body has that native source's concentration/deadline and is not silently adopted by the old parent. A countered or paid-but-failed Convergence creates/replaces nothing; being nonconcentration it displaces no unrelated concentration. All cleanup is by immutable source/body ID: an old callback cannot end a replacement.

rules.text: NEW preflight four explicit distinct whole-body boxes. Every box must be unoccupied, supported for actual body+cargo mass, within120feet of the caster and reachable by creation LoE from the caster; normal perception and physical barriers apply. Revalidate all four at resolution; if any has become illegal, the paid spell fails atomically, with no partial group or substitution. rules.text: Retain one owner-wide Bonus Action companion command and one damaging/control/support activation per numbered round across all actual companions. NEW Convergence order lifecycle: issue one perceived spoken command on an actual regular owner turn within60feet/LoE to one capable body, declaring one finite path and one legal Action/target. It executes immediately after that whole regular turn, including its extra Actions; recheck capacity, target, range and LoE at execution. Spend the shared offensive/support allowance on its admitted attack/heal/control declaration, even on miss or prevented result. Air's two attacks are one allowance; Water heal consumes the same allowance. No other companion may attack/heal/control that round. The creation turn may command if the BA remains. All uncommanded capable members receive one defensive move and Dodge at the attached phase; no autonomous Help, Ready, spell, attack or item activation. An impossible, suppressed, stale, budget-starved or controller-invalid order expires at that phase's end with no banking/replay/retarget/refund. Owner absence/death preserves its original virtual regular cadence for defensive defaults only; no new orders, offense or benefit refresh. Extra turns do not manufacture attached phases or refresh this round allowance. An independently sourced controller change cancels old orders, preserves original owner/family spending and adopts only its expressly authorized control scope.

rules.text: NEW positive two-spell route: while fused and capable on the caster's actual regular turn, one otherwise unused shared additional-full-Action slot per numbered round may be used solely to COMMIT ONE eligible Action-time actual spell. It is a spell-only additional Action, not a new turn or refresh of BA/Reaction/movement/death saves/recharge. This works for every native casting class. Both ordinary and acquired class spells remain eligible at their actual ranks; pay full costs/components/cadence and separate counter windows. The Fusion-establishing cast counts as the first actual cast that round, so after successful formation an unused additional slot may commit a second spell immediately. NEW Fusion-local ceiling: at most two actual spell commitments by this caster in a numbered round while receiving this benefit, counting all earlier actual commits that round, including countered spells and generic Ready preparation. BA/Reaction casts use their own legal budget/trigger and count toward the same two; Fusion grants neither. Long casts/rituals cannot be accelerated, Ready cannot be installed with the spell-only additional Action, and a copied release is not a fresh cast unless its exact source says so. Leaving Fusion does not impose a global cap on unrelated casting; re-entering reads the complete existing round ledger and never resets it.
